title: Selected field composition and observable-domain trace

findings.claim: The selected endpoint is only a generic rate interface with no composed field.
findings.reason: The source defines selected sums, Cartesian curl/localisation, periodisation, direct-field addition, pressure periodisation, and time activation, and packages those same fields into CandidateProperties.

findings.claim: The selected smooth-force and blow-up route is attached to the composed activated field.
findings.reason: The selected periodic candidate consumes the actual sums and returns CandidateProperties, smooth forcing, residual consequences, endpoint limits, and the axis-growth route; time activation preserves late residual equality and speed unboundedness.

findings.claim: barMoment is definitionally the five-observable functional of the final activated Cartesian field.
findings.reason: barMoment consumes ScalarField (Point P), averages a pressure-stream scalar field, and integrates in the radial variable. No inspected theorem identifies that input with the final activated Cartesian velocity/pressure observables.
